source.title_or_label: How to Create Level Maps Using 16 Tile for Sega Genesis & Mega Drive

technique.name: Per-cell tilemap attributes
technique.summary: Use tilemap descriptors to preserve palette, priority and H/V flip per 8x8 cell instead of flattening a background into a static image.

minimum_required_before_canonical: runtime screenshot or VDP dump for visual claim
current_gaps: no local validator execution in this session

promotion_decision.rationale: The technique strengthens existing tilemap and VDP owners and does not justify a standalone skill.

accepted_concepts: Per-8x8-cell tilemap descriptors carry palette, priority and H/V flip instead of flattening a background to a static image.
Palette anchoring per cell must be reconciled against the 4-palette CRAM budget.
SGDK MAP/TILESET integration is the canonical path to author 16-tile level maps.
rejected_or_deferred_claims: Any implied claim that a converted tilemap is visually correct without a runtime screenshot or VDP dump is deferred until evidence exists.
No claim that this technique alone reaches testado_em_emulador or validado_budget.
required_followups: Produce a local fixture with tilemap flags and a palette conflict report.
Capture a runtime screenshot or VDP dump before promoting any visual status.
